title: Add explicit X API search adapter
description: Implement the official X API recent-search adapter as a complementary explicit provider to xAI x_search. Use direct GET search/recent with bounded results and optional future full-archive selection, normalize post text, author/source URL, timestamp, IDs, request IDs, usage, and x-rate-limit metadata. Require separate bearer credentials and metered opt-in; never auto-route or fall back. Add deterministic fixtures and one credential-gated live smoke when available.

logs.msg: Implemented explicit official X API recent-search provider. Added bounded GET transport support, post text/author/timestamp/source normalization, x-rate-limit header parsing, metered router policy, schemas, live-smoke support, deterministic fixtures, and hard rejection of web-domain filters. X live smoke dry-run passes; real X credentials were unavailable, so live call remains skipped.
